tests: exactly one step in any workflow invokes a publish command, and it is the guarded step in the release job

dangerousStates.find: - name: Rehearsal only, nothing was published
dangerousStates.replace:
- name: Sneak a second publish into the same job
        run: npm publish --access public --provenance

      - name: Rehearsal only, nothing was published

jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Post-release notice
        run: |
          echo released
          npm publish --access public --provenance
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
